dimension_description: This scale treats FLOPs pragmatically as floating-point operations per second, the throughput measure most people mean when they compare processors, GPUs, and supercomputers. It mixes direct published device specs with reference magnitudes like gigaflops, teraflops, and exaflops. Precision mode matters in real hardware, so the notes are representative rather than exhaustive.
